title: Ida B. Wells documents lynching
summary: Journalist Ida B. Wells documented lynching in pamphlets such as Southern Horrors and The Red Record, showing it was used to terrorise Black Americans.
why: Pioneering reporting that paired lynching statistics with case accounts.

notes.problem: 'Founded data-driven reporting on racial violence' is not in the source; source says she paired data with descriptive accounts.

unsung.contribution: Documented and analysed lynching in the United States through investigative reporting.
unsung.recognition: She was honoured with a Pulitzer Prize special citation only posthumously, in 2020.
